limitations: Backtest numbers are not a claim of a live edge; only settled ledger rows can make that claim.
Ratings use final margins only: no injuries, quarterbacks, travel or weather. The stacked layer adds rest, back-to-backs and (MLB) probable-pitcher adjustments on top.
Home advantage is a single learned constant per fit; it does not vary by team or drift inside a season.
Archived lines are one consensus number per game (effectively closing), so backtest selections are graded at the close; closing-line value is measured live through the ledger.
The independent model trails the market on margin MAE (2.1193 vs 2.0802); treat it as a sanity check on the market, not a replacement for it.

NHL: the listed spread is a fixed puck line, so the market margin, edge and lean come from the no-vig moneyline converted to a margin with the game's forecast SD; cover probabilities still use the listed line.

NHL: lines are ESPN per-game multi-book medians from the 2019-20 season (earlier seasons are unpriced), matched to stats-API games by local date and team. Margins are goals with every overtime or shootout decision recorded as a one-goal margin; regular season and playoffs are included, preseason and All-Star excluded; the feed has no neutral-site flag (Global Series games abroad count as home games).
